call_sid.description: The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) the Member resource is associated with.

date_enqueued.description: The date that the member was enqueued, given in RFC 2822 format.

position.description: This member's current position in the queue.

uri.description: The URI of the resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.

wait_time.description: The number of seconds the member has been in the queue.

queue_sid.description: The SID of the Queue the member is in.
